vibe_rationale: Free, volunteer-run gathering for self-publishers since 2001; small and non-commercial, with strong culture credentials.
fit_notes: Creative, adult-leaning self-publishing crowd with weak wellness adjacency, in a free, low-key setting. Venue, fiscal and community partners only, with no cash sponsors published. Only quiet, supportive roles would land, such as a rest point, water station or commissioned zine. US-based.
